description: This file defines the SelectProfileForm class, a Drupal form used for selecting an installation profile during setup. It includes methods for building the form, handling form submission, and managing profile options, including integration with configuration directories and core profiles.

classes.name: SelectProfileForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for selecting an installation profile during setup.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the profile selection form, including profile options and configuration-based choices.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, setting the selected profile in the installation state.
